decision: Build a standalone experiment outside the json-render checkout
why: The accepted scope is feasibility measurement; existing checkout is on an unrelated feature branch
result: No core package changes; normal published renderer contract

decision: Use four approved layouts and one typed synthetic dataset
why: Measure catalog selection without allowing free-form data or topology to dominate the experiment
result: Explicit abstention for requests outside the catalog

decision: Compare Jev decisions against a deterministic baseline and a full-spec Gemini generator
why: Same catalog and task inputs; full-spec arm must not use the decision compiler
result: End-to-end architecture comparison, not model-only causality

decision: Use direct Gateway HTTP for both model arms and reserve USD 0.01 per attempt
why: Installed eligible AI SDK lacks evaluation export; fixed reservation plus bounded request/output prevents silent budget reset
result: No retries; retained reservations for failures; single workspace budget

decision: Accept probability-sum error bounded by half a decimal unit per option
why: Captured Jev v4 producer advertises two probability decimals; five individually rounded scores may differ from one by up to 0.025
result: Preserve malformed-response rejection while permitting producer rounding

decision: Keep scrollable customer region keyboard focusable with one targeted lint exception
why: Keyboard users need to enter a horizontal scroll region; generic noninteractive-tabindex lint rejects this valid case
result: Verify actual browser table region and no page overflow

decision: Stop Jev live work after the configured fx team returns RestrictedProvidersError
why: Authorized Gateway request returned 403 and named TypeSafe as restricted; do not work around a team policy
result: Comparison remains incomplete until approved provider access is configured

decision: Clarify full-spec root as a string ID before freezing the benchmark
why: The transport smoke produced a root object; previous prose omitted the root field type. This is a disclosed protocol clarification after a smoke, before any comparative request
result: Retain failed smoke; no changes to corpus labels or decision rules

decision: Use Gateway total charges including surcharges when supplied
why: The live Gemini receipt exposes cost=0.00042375 and gateway_cost=0.00052375; inference-only accounting understates the reported charge
result: Existing smoke receipt remains unchanged; corrected analysis records USD 0.00052375

decision: Use one isolated Gemini review with a separate USD 0.04 reservation
why: The decision-trail skill requests a different model family; Gemini access works through the configured Gateway and bounded HTTP avoids an unbounded reviewer tool loop
result: No TypeSafe policy bypass; review does not count as comparative data

decision: Read the clipboard once and store the user-authorized Crafter Station key under a dedicated Keychain service
why: User explicitly supplied and authorized persistent reuse of a Jev-enabled key; keep it distinct from the Vercel work credential
result: No key in argv, files, browser, or output; the previous access block is superseded subject to smoke validation

decision: Supersede uniform reservations with USD 0.004 for Jev and USD 0.01 for full-spec before comparison
why: At 12k request bytes, four Jev questions and zero output price fit below 0.004 with overhead. Full-spec retains its bounded 3072-token output allowance. Preserve all old reservations
result: 96 planned calls reserve USD 0.672, leaving room for smoke and separate review without resetting spend
